data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that displays a four‑sided stage to show 3D objects with swipeable rotation.
data.what_it_does: It provides a four‑sided stage where each side can host a widget, simulating a simple 3D object. Users can rotate the stage by swiping the bottom bar, and developers can customize content via a builder callback.
use_when: You need a lightweight way to showcase four perspectives of an object.
You want built‑in swipe navigation without implementing custom gestures.
avoid_when: You require full 3D rendering or more than four sides.
You need high‑performance graphics or physics‑based motion.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget.
weaknesses: Limited to four sides, not a full 3D engine.
Breaking changes between minor versions may require code updates.
